name: Do I need to prepare anything before interior door installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to prepare anything before interior door installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, some preparation can help ensure a smooth installation process. It's helpful to clear the area around the door opening of any furniture, decorations, or other items that might obstruct the workspace. If you are replacing an existing door, you might consider removing any old hardware, though our team can also handle this. Having your desired door choice and any specific hardware ready for review will also streamline the project. Maine Results, Inc. will provide a preparation checklist during our consultation to ensure your home in Meridian or Garden City is ready for the work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the work area of furniture and items, and have your chosen door and hardware ready; we can provide a preparation checklist.
